info.title: Sentinel Twin API
info.description: Digital twin + GAT risk engine + agent team on Razorpay (Orders, Checkout, webhooks).

post.description: One-click defense drill: attack, search for a safer policy, replay the same attack, optionally apply.

get.description: Compact summary of the most recent defense drill for the command-center strip (null if none yet).

post.description: A clean new account shares a UPI ID with a known ring, then the agent checks out (on a fork; nothing live).

get.description: Prompt-injection guard counters: blocked inputs, scrubbed tool outputs, blocked replies, refused tool calls.

post.description:
Throw the injection corpus at the agents on a throwaway copy and report what was blocked or got through.
Uses the built-in demo brain (seconds); live=true runs it against the configured LLM (slower, uses quota).
Attack the detector itself (drop ring edges + cover edges), harden it, and run RED/BLUE rounds (on a copy).

get.description: Rules only vs GAT + rules vs GAT + rules hardened, on the latest drill's orders (runs a drill if none yet).

post.description: Run a fresh drill (never applied) and return its rules-vs-graph comparison.

Rebuild the demo from TWIN_SEED: fresh twin and GAT, default policy, empty mandate spend, holds,
checkouts, receipts, proposed actions, audit trail, cases and red-team runs.

get.description: The review queue: investigator proposals, held agent checkouts, and the audit trail.

post.description: Model triage + deterministic graph evidence (claim, evidence, source) + precedent. Recorded in the ledger.
The human's decision: confirm_fraud, clear or monitor. Reason and reviewer are required (RBI-ACC-03).
Grounded copilot: answers only from the case's verified evidence and never decides.

get.description: An account's recent events in order (and, with TWIN_SEQ=1, the sequence transformer's attention on each).
A stored risk decision: decision point, time, evidence (with when and where each item came from), versions.
What survives a restart: stored decisions, graph events, model artifacts, receipts and ledger rows.

post.description: Rebuild the graph as it was at decision time, re-run the stored model and policy, compare with what was stored.

get.description: The append-only, hash-chained ledger: model recommendations and human decisions as separate records.
The reviewer twin: what it was trained on, agreement with the human, model weights, autopilot state.

post.description: Demo: a simulated reviewer works 30 synthetic cases; the twin predicts each before it is decided.

Off by default. Enabling needs a named admin and a reason (written to the ledger). It only ever releases held
checkouts under the cap at confidence >= 0.95; it never captures, refunds, restricts or moves money.

get.description: A decision receipt by receipt id, Razorpay order id or hold id.

CheckoutResult.title: CheckoutResult
CheckoutResult.description: What Razorpay Checkout's success handler returns. Empty in demo mode (the server simulates Checkout).
